text:
alex: Hey team — dropping the company-level OKR draft for Q2. Need alignment + final sign-off by EOD Fri. High level below, details in the doc link: https://redwood.work/okrs-q2-draft :wave:

alex: Draft (short):
```
O1: Make inference predictable & cheaper for customers
- KR1: Reduce avg token cost by 12% across hosted models
- KR2: 99.9% availability for premium customers
- KR3: Launch routing policy UI in Console

O2: Expand private deployment readiness
- KR1: 3 pilot customers onboarded to Private (VPC/on-prem)
- KR2: Ship basic KMS/HSM integration

O3: Developer adoption & retention
- KR1: 2x active API apps using dedicated capacity
- KR2: Improve trial-to-paid conversion to 8%
```

alex: Questions for sign-off: any objections to the numeric targets? Anything missing for legal/compliance?

maya: overall looks good. concerned about KR1 for O1 — is 12% realistic without major infra changes?

jordan: 12% is doable if we land the batching + quantization pilot. Need to scope runtime work vs infra autoscale. If we target 8% we can avoid risking other deliverables.

sam: FYI analytics shows current token cost variance across customers is high — top 10% of traffic already at -18% with caching. 12% company-wide is aggressive but not impossible. We should split KR into median and p90 to avoid skew.

emily: From finance POV, commit level is fine but we should add a revenue-linked KR for Private pilots (milestones = contract signature triggers). Otherwise forecasting gets fuzzy.

alex: Good point @emily. Proposal: add O2 KR3: "Secure PO or signed term sheet for >=1 pilot by end of Q2" — ok?

maya: yes add that. Also @jordan — can you share a one-paragraph risk note about runtime changes (impact on SLOs) by Tue? Execs want to understand tradeoffs.

jordan: Yep will do. Quick note: the biggest risk is KV cache invalidation during rollout — we have a mitigation (canary + traffic shaping) but need QA cycles.

sam: I'll add suggested metric changes: split O1.KR1 into median token cost -12% and O1.KR1b p90 token cost -6%. Sending a small diff to the doc now.

alex: added emily's revenue KR and sam's metric split in the doc. Updated link: https://redwood.work/okrs-q2-draft?v=2 :white_check_mark:

okrbot: Reminder: company OKR sign-off window closes on 2025-04-04 17:00 UTC. Submit objections via thread.

maya: My sign-off: +1 with the changes (alex to incorporate).

jordan: +1 from Eng pending the risk note on Tue.

emily: +1 (finance) — good to go once pilot revenue KR is visible in forecast.

sam: +1 on metrics. Will coordinate evaluation dashboards with DevEx.

alex: Thanks — I'll merge final doc and notify all. Action items: jordan -> risk note (Tue), emily -> revenue forecast line, sam -> dashboards. Will ping when merged. :handshake:

alex: merged final and sent to execs: https://redwood.work/okrs-q2-final. Closing thread. :tada:
